evidence.claim: The localized landing route composes hero, proof, fit, services, pricing, process, aftercare, engagement, design, stack, FAQ and contact in buyer-question order.
The hero presents localized value copy, a project lead prompt and a link to project proof.
The services section renders titled offers with explanatory bodies and included points.
The pricing section models tier name, range, time, body, inclusions and exclusions and explicitly defers exact pricing to discovery.
The process section renders four delivery steps with title, body and indicative duration.
The projects surface filters project cases by category and renders highlights, technology stack and a contact CTA.
The contact section owns idle/sending/sent/error states, lead fields, calendar/email alternatives and submit action.
The contact API validates name/email/message, fails when delivery is unconfigured, forwards timestamped leads and reports upstream failure.
